posts.hook: You have less time than you think.
posts.caption:
You have less time than you think.

“…postponement is the greatest waste of life: it wrings day after day from us, and takes away the present by promising something hereafter: there is no such obstacle to true living as waiting, which loses today while it is depending on the morrow.”
— Seneca, On the Shortness of Life 9
